text:
maya: quick thread  partner asked for a CSV export of provisional billing previews that maps to our ledger rows. they want it nightly so their finance ops can reconcile before month close.
rolf: we already compute provisional rows during finalization window, but no export endpoint. could add /partners/{id}/billing-preview.csv that returns latest snapshot.
keiko: CSV columns should be: invoice_period_start, invoice_period_end, customer_id, sku, usage_units, unit_price_cents, provisional_amount_cents, ledger_row_id, source, reported_timestamp_utc, confidence_score
billing-bot: New epic created: MP-4301  partner-billing-csv-export (owner: keiko).
simon: couple asks from partner: 1) include entitlement_id per row 2) flag rows that are likely backfills (late_arrival boolean) 3) include dedupe_key if provided.
anne: policy: provisional CSV is for planning only. ledger (finalized rows post-dispute window) is authoritative. add conspicuous banner in CSV header and file footer.
maya: also need rate limiting on the export. partners will hit it with automation. propose daily export by default, hourly if partner has enterprise plan and token-scoped permission.
rolf: technical: we can produce the CSV from the same materialized view used by billing pipelines; add a column exported_at_utc and export_version so partner can assert idempotency.
keiko: sample CSV row example line (pipe-delimited preview to avoid quoting chaos):
```
2026-06-01T00:00Z|2026-06-30T23:59Z|cust-ACME-42|api-embedding|125000|2|250000|lr-20260620-0001|redwood_marketplace|2026-06-20T02:12:00Z|0.92
```
maya: dispute process note: partner can open a reconciliation ticket referencing ledger_row_id within 7 days of CSV export or within 7 days of ledger finalization, whichever is later.
simon: we should include a checksum header so partners can verify file integrity (sha256 hex). include manifest file for multi-part exports.
anne: update TOS addendum for partners to allow provisional previews but clarify no entitlement to credit until final ledger. exceptions for ingestion bugs.
keiko: action items: keiko -> spec CSV fields + sample; rolf -> API auth + rate-limit plan; maya -> draft partner-facing FAQ blurb + dispute template; simon -> manifest/checksum + multi-part export support.
billing-bot: Reminder: sync with ACME finance on Thu 16:00 PT.
maya: thanks all, i'll share a stub export link and the sample CSV in the sync doc. :thumbsup:
